rules: The header button, Ctrl+K, and / open a task search dialog in the local laboratory.
Search is accent-insensitive and matches terms in any order across task title, company, owner, sector, status, month, and due date.
Every result is filtered through canWork for the active profile; selecting it rechecks access before opening the task.
Opening a result changes the task page and period while preserving the active actor identity.
The result list is capped at ten and prioritizes current-period, open work.

assertions: accent-insensitive query returns both matching tasks in the active employee scope
selecting a result opens its task detail
existing desktop/mobile correction flows still pass

buildNotes: Vite reports the existing informational main JavaScript chunk warning above 500 kB; build succeeds.

limitations: Task data remains in browser-local paris-state-lab and does not synchronize between devices.
No customer data, account, operational API, D1, or Supabase is used.
This does not add server-side search or alter authorization rules.
